perpetrators found.
Three robbers armed with a gun and knife boarded a bulk 
carrier under way and took hostage an engine crew while 
they stole engine spares. The crew reported the incident to 
the bridge after the robbers had escaped. Alarm raised, crew 
mustered and a search was carried out. VTIS Central 
informed. Upon anchoring the coast guard boarded the 
vessel for inspection. All crew safe.
An engine crew taken 
hostage, engine spares 
stolen
Acts of piracy and armed robbery allegedly committed against ships reported by
Member States or international organizations in consultative status
Details of the incident Consequences for 
crew, ship, cargo Coastal State Action Taken
While underway, two unarmed perpetrators were sighted on 
deck by crew. The ship’s general alarm was activated, and all 
crew members were mustered and accounted for. The crew 
was not injured and nothing was stolen. No further assistance 
was required.
The incident was reported to Singapore Vessel Traffic 
Information System (VTIS). Safety broadcast on anti-piracy 
watch was carried out to warn all vessels to maintain a 
vigilant watch at all times in the Singapore Strait (SS). The 
Republic of Singapore Navy (RSN) and Singapore Police 
Coast Guard (SPCG) were notified of the incident. 
Information was shared with the Indonesian authority.
Upon arrival at Pilot Eastern Boarding Ground B (PEBGB), 
SPCG boarded the vessel and conducted a search onboard, 
with no perpetrators found.
Nothing was stolen.
The crew was not injured. 
Three unauthorised persons boarded a barge under tow and 
escaped with stolen barge’s properties. Barge’s properties stolen NA
